title: Access Control is domain admission
summary: AccessControlAuthority evaluates a sealed AccessControlRequest against a sealed AccessControlPolicy to decide whether a principal may cross a protected domain boundary. Context is part of the request and policy is deny-by-default.
invariants: The request binds request id, principal id, domain id, entry point, intended time, and snapshotted contextual attributes.
Highest numeric priority wins; DENY wins equal-priority mixed-action ties; same-action ties use lexical rule id.
A successful Access Control decision establishes admission only; it is not a method capability.

provenance.claim: Access Control is protected-domain admission with deterministic priority, DENY tie-breaking, and default DENY.
AccessControlAuthority implements sealed/effective checks, attribution binding, rule selection, default policy action, proof wrapping, and DENY-wins equal priority selection.
